hypervisors.removal.title: Host removal review
hypervisors.removal.scopeTitle: Remove only the Nova compute registration
hypervisors.removal.scopeWarning: Physical equipment, other OpenStack services, VMs and storage are not deleted. The operator must personally confirm physical shutdown and that the nova-compute process is stopped. Afterglow does not perform or prove these remotely. down or forced_down is not proof of actual shutdown.
hypervisors.removal.busy: Processing the host operation request. Approval inputs are unavailable.
hypervisors.removal.eligibleTitle: Removal conditions met at check time
hypervisors.removal.eligibleHelp: This report is not a reservation or a guarantee of completion. On submission, the server rechecks the state and review contents.
hypervisors.removal.ineligibleHelp: Review and resolve blocked or unverifiable reasons in the checks below, then run a new check.
hypervisors.removal.serviceUpdatedAt: Service update / last communication reference time (updated_at)
hypervisors.removal.heartbeatWarning: updated_at is a Nova service update / last communication reference value, not a ping measurement time. heartbeat down alone cannot prove physical shutdown or process stoppage, and forced_down=true is not proof of a heartbeat timeout.
hypervisors.removal.storedObservationWar: The last observed uptime and host_time are actual past observations at the observed_at time above. The current uptime query is unavailable and does not prove current connectivity or that a process is running/stopped.
hypervisors.removal.noUptimeHelp: Uptime unavailable (unavailable). No usable observation exists. An unavailable uptime query alone does not block removal of a down host.
hypervisors.removal.liveUptimeHelp: Current uptime is raw reference information, not proof of actual process stoppage.
hypervisors.removal.currentServersHelp: These are the current host server query results across all projects. soft-deleted servers are also included in the checks.
hypervisors.removal.historyTitle: Retained deleted servers and migration history
hypervisors.removal.historyWarning: Only deleted servers and migrations retained and returned by Nova are shown. Purged history, records outside the retention scope or activity in other systems may not be included. Empty history is not proof that a host has never been used.
hypervisors.removal.migrationsEmpty: No retained migration history was returned. This does not mean there was no past activity.
hypervisors.removal.placementHelp: Shows the report’s root and child providers and all consumer/resource allocation values. The UI does not modify Placement or delete allocations.
hypervisors.removal.allocationsEmpty: No allocations were returned. Review the removal condition checks to confirm whether the query succeeded.
hypervisors.removal.providersEmpty: No providers were returned. Review the removal condition checks for unverifiable mapping or query reasons.
hypervisors.removal.approvalHelp: Approval covers only the single host in the report. The review token expires in 5 minutes and is single-use. A new check, a host/project/state change, expiry or failure requires a new report and all confirmation inputs.
hypervisors.removal.approvalConsumed: This review approval has already been submitted. It cannot be reused; run a new check.
hypervisors.removal.approvalUnavailable: The current report cannot be approved or the review approval has expired. Run a new removal check.
hypervisors.removal.approvalInvalidated: The previous report is retained for reference. Approval is unavailable until a new check report arrives.

hypervisors.removal.noReport: Run a removal check to review the service, current servers, retained history, Placement and blocking reasons. Removal cannot be approved without a report.
